# Keybindings

<!-- auto-generated by .scripts/hypr-keybindings-doc from .config/hypr/hyprland.lua — do not edit -->

## Window/stack management

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Super + J` | `window.cycle_next` |
| `Super + K` | `window.cycle_next next=false` |
| `Super + Shift + J` | `window.swap next=true` |
| `Super + Shift + K` | `window.swap prev=true` |
| `Super + Ctrl + Space` | `layout focusmaster` |
| `Super + Space` | `layout swapwithmaster` |
| `Super + Shift + Space` | `window.float action=toggle` |
| `Super + Q` | `window.close` |
| `Super + Shift + Q` | `hypr-quit  (really quit the app; tray apps only hide on mod+Q)` |
| `Super + F` | `window.fullscreen mode=fullscreen` |
| `Super + H` | `layout mfact -0.05` |
| `Super + L` | `layout mfact +0.05` |
| `Super + O` | `layout addmaster` |
| `Super + Shift + O` | `layout removemaster` |
| `Super + S` | `window.pin` |
| `Super + B` | `pkill -SIGUSR1 waybar` |

## Layouts (dwm-style glyphs published by hypr-layout)

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Super + T` | `hypr-layout tile` |
| `Super + Shift + T` | `hypr-layout bstack` |
| `Super + Y` | `hypr-layout spiral` |
| `Super + Shift + Y` | `hypr-layout dwindle` |
| `Super + U` | `hypr-layout deck` |
| `Super + Shift + U` | `window.fullscreen mode=maximized` |
| `Super + I` | `hypr-layout centered` |
| `Super + Shift + I` | `hypr-layout centered` |

## Workspaces 1-9 (+Shift silent move)

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Super + 1` | `focus workspace=1` |
| `Super + 2` | `focus workspace=2` |
| `Super + 3` | `focus workspace=3` |
| `Super + 4` | `focus workspace=4` |
| `Super + 5` | `focus workspace=5` |
| `Super + 6` | `focus workspace=6` |
| `Super + 7` | `focus workspace=7` |
| `Super + 8` | `focus workspace=8` |
| `Super + 9` | `focus workspace=9` |
| `Super + Shift + 1` | `window.move workspace=1 follow=false` |
| `Super + Shift + 2` | `window.move workspace=2 follow=false` |
| `Super + Shift + 3` | `window.move workspace=3 follow=false` |
| `Super + Shift + 4` | `window.move workspace=4 follow=false` |
| `Super + Shift + 5` | `window.move workspace=5 follow=false` |
| `Super + Shift + 6` | `window.move workspace=6 follow=false` |
| `Super + Shift + 7` | `window.move workspace=7 follow=false` |
| `Super + Shift + 8` | `window.move workspace=8 follow=false` |
| `Super + Shift + 9` | `window.move workspace=9 follow=false` |
| `Super + 0` | `hypr-windows` |
| `Super + Shift + 0` | `hyprexpo:expo toggle` |
| `Super + Tab` | `focus workspace=previous` |
| `Super + G` | `focus workspace=r-1` |
| `Super + ;` | `focus workspace=r+1` |
| `Super + Shift + G` | `window.move workspace=r-1` |
| `Super + Shift + ;` | `window.move workspace=r+1` |
| `Super + PgUp` | `focus workspace=r-1` |
| `Super + PgDn` | `focus workspace=r+1` |
| `Super + Shift + PgUp` | `window.move workspace=r-1` |
| `Super + Shift + PgDn` | `window.move workspace=r+1` |

## Monitors

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Super + left` | `focus monitor=-1` |
| `Super + right` | `focus monitor=+1` |
| `Super + Shift + left` | `workspace.move monitor=-1` |
| `Super + Shift + right` | `workspace.move monitor=+1` |
| `Super + Ctrl + left` | `window.move monitor=-1` |
| `Super + Ctrl + right` | `window.move monitor=+1` |

## Volume

| `Super + Shift + M` | `wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ toggle && barsig 10` |

| `Super + Shift + -` | `wpctl set-volume -l 1.5 @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ 10%- && barsig 10` |
| `Super + =` | `wpctl set-volume -l 1.5 @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ 3%+ && barsig 10` |
| `Super + Shift + =` | `wpctl set-volume -l 1.5 @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ 10%+ && barsig 10` |
